items.name: Tim T.
items.quote: Excellent experience dealing with Paul at the RV farm. Video tours of the trailer, paid remotely and trailer delivered all in one day! A+ experience. Will be back if we ever need to upgrade!

items.name: Sandra A.
items.quote: We consigned our camper trailer to Paul and his team. What a great and painless experience. They picked up our trailer, had our agreement ready to sign and took it back to their yard in a painless transaction. I highly recommend Paul and the RV Farm. Very knowledgeable and experienced. A+++++

items.name: Denise F.
items.quote: So excited! Just bought the 2008 Wilderness from Paul who is a great salesman and very upfront. I would highly recommend these guys!

items.name: Judy H.
items.quote: We purchased a 2010 Fourwinds from the RV Farm in Woodbridge this week. Paul took the time to go through every detail with us about the trailer. Very personable and very reasonable to deal with. I would highly recommend RV Farm for purchasing your trailer.
